speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To determine the cause of this jaundice, how many hours after birth did these symptoms first appear?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding-associated jaundice (exaggerated physiological jaundice)

The baby is 2 weeks old and exclusively breastfed, which fits the clinical picture of breastfeeding jaundice where intake may be insufficient. I will request a serum bilirubin level and thyroid function tests to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other causes. REQUEST TEST: Total_Bilirubin, Direct_Bilirubin, TSH, T4
